title: Section Student Congress 2025
theme: Leadership, innovation, technical excellence, and professional networking
summary: Section Student Congress 2025 brought together IEEE student members, branch counselors, faculty advisors, industry professionals, and student branches across the Hyderabad Section.
description: Section Student Congress 2025 was conducted on 13 December 2025 at Vardhaman College of Engineering. The congress created a common platform for IEEE student members, branch counselors, faculty advisors, industry professionals, and student volunteers to explore IEEE opportunities, emerging technologies, leadership, innovation, and professional networking.
outcomes: 320+ participants across IEEE students, non-IEEE students, and IEEE professionals
Student branch collaboration and section-wide IEEE volunteer networking
